title: Mutes and plunger use
summary: He seldom uses a mute himself but used straight and cup mutes with Duke; he used a plunger when younger, as Sidney still does.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: did you ever use many mutes?
in my own personal playing I seldom use a mute but in a lot of the things that I had to do in Duke's band I did use mutes
see and what kind of mutes did you use?
did you ever use a plunger?
yes I used to but not with I didn't with Duke I used to use a plunger in fact Sidney and I both Sidney still used a plunger but when I was younger I used to use a plunger quite a bit
